tests: Choosing a DB and capacity mode for key-value access with unpredictable spikes and no capacity planning.
expected: DynamoDB with on-demand capacity. Triggers: "highly unpredictable, spiky traffic", "single-digit-millisecond", "key-value", "no capacity planning".
why_not: Provisioned without auto scaling throttles at peaks; RDS is relational OLTP and requires planning; Redshift is an OLAP warehouse.
